hint.message: Changes apply after reloading the game page.

storageInfo.message: Addon files stay in this Chrome profile. Removing an addon preserves its game settings. Built-in addons are managed in the game library.

limits.message: Limits: ZIP 128 MB; unpacked archive 256 MB; file 64 MB; library 384 MB.

reloadInfo.message: Reload the game page when you are ready to interrupt the session.

empty.message: No local addons. Import a ZIP.

saved.message: Saved. Reload the game to apply changes.

imported.message: Imported. New addons are disabled by default.

dependencies.message: Check required dependencies: {names}. They may be installed in the game library.

loadError.message: Loader error. The game may start without local addons.

importError.message: Could not import the archive. Technical details:

interfaceWarning.message: The TOC does not declare Interface 30300. Compatibility is unverified.

errorExpanded.message: Unpacked data exceeds the 64 MB per-file or 256 MB archive limit.

errorUnsupported.message: Unsupported ZIP format: encryption, ZIP64, multiple volumes, symbolic links or compression method.

errorZip.message: The ZIP archive is invalid or damaged.

errorUnexpected.message: The operation failed. Check browser storage space and try again.

diagHint.message: Enable CatQuest, enter the game and run /cq probe 606. The game's requests for voice files appear here.

diagNoRead.message: The addon loaded, but the game never requested a voice file. The path is not visible: the Lasthavens file system needs investigation.

diagSync.message: The game reads audio synchronously. Reads served from cache: {count}.

diagAsync.message: The game reads audio asynchronously: option A fits.

voiceLocaleHint.message: Tracks for this language are voiced on demand: a quest without voice-over is sent to the server when first opened, and the audio arrives in about 30 seconds. Takes effect after reloading the game.

capacity.message: Voice server: {queue} in queue, {used} of {limit} this hour, one track ≈ {seconds} s, budget covers ≈ {budget} tracks.

capacityLimited.message: Hourly limit reached, next in {minutes} min.

capacityOff.message: Generation is off on the server: only ready tracks play.

earlyUpdatesHint.message: Turn on to receive beta addons before the stable release. Off by default.

updatesOffline.message: Update server unavailable ({error}); will retry later.

updatesAddonInstalled.message: {name} {version} downloaded from the server and enabled; reload the game page.

updatesAddonUpdated.message: {name} updated to {version}; reload the game page.

updatesExtension.message: An extension version from the selected channel is available: {version} (you have {current}).

updatesHowTo.message: Download the archive, unpack it over the folder you installed the extension from (replacing files), then press "Restart extension".

telemetryLabel.message: Send statistics, my character and errors

telemetryHint.message: Shows who uses the voice-over, what to voice first and where it breaks: a random install number, versions, language, counters, character name and realm, ordered quests and error reports with the last diagnostics events. No IP is stored. Turn it off and the extension sends none of this.

accountOffline.message: The account is unavailable. Check the connection and statistics switch.

accountHint.message: Keep the recovery code safe. After reinstalling the extension, register the new install and enter the code here to restore characters, settings and heard places.

placesScopeAccount.message: Account: new characters do not repeat

accountCodeSaved.message: A new code was created. Save it somewhere safe.

accountLinked.message: Install linked to the account. Reload the game page.

accountLinkFailed.message: Could not link the install. Check the code and connection.
